title: Design System: SACC — Sana Al-Awael Contracting Company

referenceImplementation.approvedProposal: proposal 6 (bento), revised by the owner-requested B2B pass

page-night.note: Also --on-lav: text on lavender state fills.

deep-teal.note: Every feature plate; register row divider.

slate-surface.note: Information plates: register, recognition band, panels, forms.

lavender.note: Primary text; fills only selected filters/tabs, in-progress pill, notice, skip link. No lavender content plates.

action-violet.note: Contact action and form submit buttons only.

survey-grey.note: Borders of form fields and approval chips only.

earth.note: Defined in site.css (--earth) but not used by any shipped surface.

display.purpose: Page H1 only, weight 600. Arabic line-height 1.35.

title.purpose: H3: 500 on discipline tiles, 400 on node, project and people cards; drawer links.

lead.purpose: Line under H1/H2 in Lavender Mist; Lavender and 52ch in the hero.

body.purpose: Running text. Arabic line-height 1.8; 44ch max in tiles.

label.purpose: Nav, meta, chips, pills, register headers (500), field and credential labels, footer.

fonts.arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic 300/400/500/600 (@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans-arabic, arabic subset)

figure.purpose: Credential values under the hero, 500, line-height 1, tabular numerals.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for every transition.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, outline, tone and pill state changes; tiles and project cards 220ms.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: Tiles and project cards on hover; the contact action presses 1px down.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Section entrance; content already on screen is never hidden.

motion.name: line-draw
motion.value: clip-path inset reveal, 1100ms, 200ms delay, in reading direction
motion.purpose: Discipline line drawings draw in once.

motion.name: pinned-band
motion.purpose: Hero photo band stays fixed while the disciplines section slides over it.

breakpoints.name: nav
breakpoints.note: main nav to drawer; disciplines 2-up; project cards 2-up; leadership and form grid stack

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.note: hero, page-head, split, closing band stack

breakpoints.name: register
breakpoints.note: credentials 2-up; register becomes compact cards (name, owner, status); facts 2-up

breakpoints.name: single
breakpoints.note: disciplines 1-up with drawings hidden; band shows two photos; fields 1-up

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.note: Arabic hero H1 kept on one line; chair card stacks

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.note: bar compacts; seals become a list

breakpoints.name: tiny
breakpoints.note: contact action leaves the bar and shows in the drawer

background.purpose: The site-plan grid was removed in the B2B pass.

narrative.overview:
The site reads as a calm engineering sheet on a plain night-blue ground. Solid, rounded plates in two dark tones, deep teal and slate, carry the content. The discipline tiles hold thin periwinkle line drawings of pipes, culverts, road sections, bridges and lab specimens, with small round nodes like a utility network diagram. The register is institutional and orderly: firm sentence-case headings at moderate sizes, wide section spacing, a project register laid out as a real table, and field photographs in full natural colour.

The character comes from the owner's reference (Sirion): a deep blue-green ground, one saturated accent kept for the single action, a discipline grid, a recognition band, portrait cards and a split closing band. The B2B pass made the system calmer and plainer for evaluators. Headings got heavier, the background site-plan grid was removed, the lavender plates were taken out (every plate is now dark), and the figures moved into a credentials strip under the hero. Colours come only from the owner's palette, always solid at full strength. Proof carries the page: ISO seals, named approvals, figures, owners and named projects.

Arabic is the root language and the layout is built with logical properties, so the English page under /en mirrors it without overrides. Everything that has a direction follows the reading direction: line-drawing reveals, arrows, band clip shapes and tab arrow keys.
keyCharacteristics: Plain night-blue ground; flat solid dark plates (teal and slate), no shadows.
Lavender is text and selected state; violet fills only the contact action and form submits.
Thin 1.5px engineering line drawings with round nodes on the discipline tiles.
Medium (500) headings with a 600 H1, sentence case, moderate sizes.
Arabic-first RTL, logical properties throughout, full-colour photography.

rules.name: The Full-Strength Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a solid fill at full strength. There are no gradients, no transparency washes, no glass or blur, and no scrims, greyscale or desaturation on photographs.

rules.name: The Dark Plate Rule
rules.body: Content plates are Teal or Slate, never Lavender. Lavender fills only small state elements (selected filter or tab, in-progress pill, notice, skip link).

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Violet fills the contact action and the form submits and nothing else. Neither Action Violet (3.90:1) nor Survey Grey (3.94:1) is ever text on a dark background.

rules.name: The Untouched Logo Rule
rules.body: The SACC lockup appears in its own colours, only resized. It is never recoloured, redrawn or placed on a tinted chip.

rules.name: The Firm Voice Rule
rules.body: Headings are 500 (H1 600), sentence case, never uppercase, and stop at 3.5rem. Hierarchy comes from size steps and position, not from extra weights or larger display sizes.

rules.name: The Arabic Leading Rule
rules.body: Arabic gets taller line-heights (body 1.8, display 1.35, headline 1.4) and zero letter-spacing. Latin headings take -0.01em. Numerals use lining tabular figures, and phone numbers and figures are isolated LTR.

rules.name: The Logical Properties Rule
rules.body: Inline layout uses only `inline-start/end`, `margin-inline` and `padding-inline`. Anything with a physical direction (clip-paths, reveal direction, arrows, tab keys) is mirrored explicitly for RTL.

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: Plates are solid and shadowless. State shows as an outline colour, an underline or a small lift, never as a shadow or glow.

rules.name: The One Contact Action Rule
rules.body: One contact action («تواصل معنا» / Contact Us) is visible at a time. On the home page the bar's copy stays hidden until the hero's action has scrolled out of view; on the contact page the form stands in for it. Sections never repeat it.

dos: **Do** use the palette colours solid at full strength, with Teal and Slate as the only plate tones.
**Do** keep text Lavender or Lavender Mist on dark, and Page Night on Lavender state fills.
**Do** set headings at 500 (H1 600) in sentence case, within the type steps above.
**Do** draw new engineering illustrations as 1.5px round-capped periwinkle strokes with round nodes.
**Do** present comparable records (projects, figures) as plain tables and lists, stacking to compact cards on phones.
**Do** write layout with logical properties and mirror every directional effect for RTL.
**Do** give every interactive element a visible 2px periwinkle focus ring and a 44px target.
donts: **Don't** use gradients, transparency washes, glass, blur, scrims or greyscale and desaturated photos.
**Don't** build Lavender content plates (tiles, cards, bands); Lavender fills are for state only.
**Don't** set Action Violet or Survey Grey as text on a dark background, or use violet beyond the contact action and form submits.
**Don't** add a second contact action to a section, or a sitemap-style footer.
**Don't** add box-shadows or a background pattern; show state with outline, underline or a small lift.
**Don't** recolour, redraw or tint the SACC logo.
**Don't** render small uppercase eyebrow labels above headings. The content data carries `eyebrow` strings, but the shipped design does not show them.
**Don't** invent certificate artwork, client logos or testimonials. Seals stay typographic.
